_note: Plan 253 Phase 0 surface-coverage register: every delivery, import and source-census path, with what it carries for creative rights today. tests/rights-coverage.test.ts keeps it whole: every export format, every format in docs/site/formats-catalog.json, every drop route, every web file that hands bytes to a download, share or clipboard, every Send driver and every file that builds a provenance ingredient or evaluates rights must be registered here, every code path must exist, and any status that claims something must point at a test that proves the claim. Statuses describe the route, not a promise about a work: a delivery route can only carry the sources the census paths hand it, and only the emoji census is complete today. To register a new path, add an entry with an honest status; when in doubt it is not-assessed.

statuses.covered: Source credits are written into a Content Credential and a readable credit is prepared, and the route reads the delivered bytes back and says credits are included only when every required source is found.
statuses.metadata-only: Credits or licence records travel as readable text beside the work, such as a CREDITS.txt companion, or as declared records, with no Content Credential carrying them.
statuses.credential-only: A Content Credential travels or is collected, such as a source's own credential carried as an ingredient or a capture credential. No licence is evaluated, no credit is prepared and no receipt is measured.
statuses.raw-utility: Bytes or text the person asked for that are not a creative delivery (a report, app data, a link, their own table values), or an on-device transform of their own file. It adds no source credit and claims none.
statuses.not-assessed: No coverage is claimed. Either the path has not been traced, or it moves bytes without evaluating source terms or carrying a source credit. The note says which, and what is known.
statuses.by-format: The status depends on the output format and is recorded per format in exportFormats.

library._note: Engine modules that define the rules, the credential writer and the readers. They build ingredients and evaluate rights for the paths below and are not paths themselves.

c2pa-readback.test: every stampable format is round-tripped by SOME suite, none silently untested
a real stamped file reads back confirmed, and a file missing the source does not
an export reads its own bytes back before it says the credits are in the file
a credential that was never written never reads as delivered

paths.title: Tool export from the export panel, the tool view and Record
paths.note: The runtime evaluates the census and hands the plan to host.export.render; the bridge stamps every format in C2PA_FORMATS and reads the finished bytes back before reporting a receipt. With Content Credentials off, or for an on-device tool, no credential is written and the receipt reports the credit as not delivered. A retry from the delivery panel re-hands the same bytes.

paths.title: Bytes a creative tool's own hook supplies: exportStill (deep stills, a palette's .ase) and Darkroom's layered PSD
paths.note: The runtime returns tool-supplied bytes verbatim, with no watermark and no engine provenance, so no credential, credit or receipt travels with them.

paths.title: On-device transforms of the person's own file: utility exportFile hooks, Convert, PDF extract and Office to Markdown
paths.note: Bytes in, bytes out on the device, through host.export.file or a direct download. Nothing adds or claims a source credit, and a third party's credit can be lost in the conversion; Convert keeps a JSON report per file and per batch.

paths.title: Strip metadata from a file (Verify and the strip-data utility)

evidence.test: a strip that removed somebody else's credit says so, and offers the credit
the strip note never claims the credit was handled

paths.note: Removal is the point. Verify's strip note counts the source credits the file no longer carries and offers the credit text; stripped bytes are never restamped.

paths.title: Prepare for sharing: prepared copies, the recipe and the report
paths.note: Not traced for rights. The panel downloads or delivers the prepared copies, a preparation recipe and a report; whether a third party's credit survives a preparation is not checked.

paths.title: Copy image and copy rich text from the export panel
paths.note: Copy image renders a PNG and writes the pixels to the clipboard. The evaluator knows a clipboard carries no credit (tests/fixtures/rights/clipboard-delivery-missing.json), but the copy actions do not tell the runtime the route is a clipboard.

paths.title: Copy table values as text (table inputs, Batch cells)
paths.note: Copies the person's own table values as TSV and an HTML table. No creative source travels.

paths.title: System share sheet for a file
paths.note: Hands the prepared bytes to navigator.share. Whatever the bytes carry travels; nothing is evaluated for the share itself and the receiving app may strip metadata.

paths.title: Share a link to a tool or asset
paths.note: Shares a URL, not bytes. The page the link opens is its own delivery.

paths.title: Catalog Download original and share from a tile
paths.note: Delivers the stored bytes. A user upload whose ingest captured a credential is wrapped in a Lolly manifest that opens the original as an ingredient (credentialedBytes); no test pins that wrap. No licence is evaluated and no credit or receipt is produced. When fetch fails, saveUrl falls back to an anchor that hands over the raw bytes.

paths.title: Catalog Download as, recolour, colour treatment and crop

evidence.test: a provenance-promising conversion refuses an unstampable container
catalog crop preserves the genAI flag AND the full Lolly journey

paths.note: Changed bytes are re-signed with the source's own credential as an ingredient when the source has one. An unsigned source with a recorded licence contributes no ingredient and no credit, and nothing is read back for credits.

paths.title: Catalog bulk Download as one ZIP
paths.note: Members use the same byte rule as Download original and are checked with the verifier for the announcement. The ZIP holds no credits index binding each name to its output hash and sources (plan 253, section 7.3).

paths.title: Send to a connected destination
paths.note: From the export panel the bytes come through the tool export route, so a stampable format carries its credential. No destination has a capability profile: a provider accepting the upload is not evidence that a credit reached a reader (plan 253, section 8.2).

paths.title: Derived assets: matte, upscale, retouch, crop, audio extraction and video jobs

evidence.test: runVideoJob matte: raster+animated record, plain-edit stamp, source ingredient carried
catalog crop preserves the genAI flag AND the full Lolly journey

paths.note: The new bytes carry the source's own credential as an ingredient where it has one. requireCredential applies only where a caller passes it; otherwise an unstampable format or a signing failure returns the unsigned blob. An unsigned source's licence and credit do not travel (plan 253, section 2).

paths.title: Downloads of stored files: asset versions, project assets, team files, clips and recovery originals
paths.note: Hands over stored bytes exactly as kept. Sending a stored file is still a delivery (plan 253, section 7.3), and none of these evaluates source terms or adds a credit.

paths.title: Editable .lolly file from a session, a project or the share dialog

evidence.test: a built .lolly carries CREDITS.txt, under the integrity map, and still opens
the credits file lists what travelled, what did not, and the reason for each
the file is built from this session alone, with licensed catalog bytes held back

paths.note: Catalog bytes travel only under a reviewed licence that permits passing them on; CREDITS.txt lists what travelled, what was held back and why, and records an inclusion the sender chose. No receipt is measured from the finished file.

paths.title: Share a design as a reusable tool (Share with rules, reusable posters, session tools)
paths.note: The compilers refuse a source whose recorded licence does not permit passing it on unless the author confirms, and keep a credit line per bundled dependency. No test pins those lines and no credits file or receipt is produced.

paths.title: Template share and export as a template file
paths.note: Whether a catalog asset may travel is still decided by a licence-name pattern (proprietary, all-rights-reserved, licenseref, premiumbeat) rather than the reviewed rules.

paths.title: Brand pack, design system package, tokens and font package exports
paths.note: Fonts, logos and tokens travel. The design system package keeps licensed dependencies as external references, decided by the same licence-name pattern as template share; a font package labels itself OFL only when every font is redistributable. No credits file or receipt.

paths.title: Palette swatch downloads
paths.note: Colour values and names in swatch formats. The tokens download that bundles fonts is part of the brand pack export.

paths.title: Export an emoji set and download emoji credits
paths.note: The set export bundles a pack's manifest and every glyph's artwork with no licence check and no credits file. The credits download is the readable credit text for the emoji placed in the document, not a work.

paths.title: Text and text asset exports (Markdown, HTML, RTF, DOCX, ODT)
paths.note: Text the person wrote or kept as an asset. No source record exists for quoted text, and nothing is inferred from a quotation or a name (plan 253, section 6.2).

paths.title: Presentation recordings

evidence.test: a transcoded take adds an honest c2pa.converted step after the capture

paths.note: The take carries a capture credential recording how it was made. It does not identify any work shown on screen.

paths.title: 3D Studio contact sheets
paths.note: Drawn on a canvas and saved as a PNG with no credential. Scene models and textures are not recorded.

paths.title: Rebrand: the renovated deck and the project file
paths.note: Not traced for rights. No credits file or receipt is produced.

paths.title: Projects: download or share originals and sessions as a ZIP
paths.note: Zips the stored originals the project uses. No credits file, and no licence check before the bytes are shared.

paths.title: Data backup and Export everything
paths.note: A backup of this device's data for another install. It can hold library assets that are other people's works, and it carries no credits file. Not traced for which history and source bytes it includes (plan 253, section 11).

paths.title: Saved history archives
paths.note: Revisions carry their recorded rights decisions. Not traced for which source bytes an archive includes.

paths.title: App surfaces exported as Penpot files
paths.note: Renders an app-owned surface with the active brand through the Penpot writer. Brand assets travel and no source is recorded.

paths.title: Batch renders and their ZIP
paths.note: Each row renders through the runtime with the session's recorded decisions, so a stampable row carries its credential. No per-output rights receipt is shown and the ZIP holds no credits index (plan 253, section 7.3).

paths.title: Verify's signed report
paths.note: The report PDF is signed and checked before it is saved. It has no Sources section yet, so the report does not repeat the file's source credits.

paths.title: Reports, recovery files and app data
paths.note: Evidence and production reports, design context, recovery copies, rate card templates, the AI instructions text and the batch CSV. None is a creative delivery.

paths.title: Public catalog previews (signed renditions)

evidence.test: signed rendition preserves the original parent, credits and exact cached bytes

paths.note: A rendition is signed with the original as its parent ingredient and keeps the native EXIF credits and the catalog credit record. No licence is evaluated.

paths.title: CLI render

evidence.test: a CC BY set prints its credit and exits 0
a recoloured CC BY-SA set names the decision, writes the file, and exits non-zero

paths.note: Covered for formats in C2PA_FORMATS with Content Credentials on: the Rights block reads the written file back before saying credits are in the file. For any other format it prints the credit and records no delivery.

paths.title: MCP lolly_render, browser-free tier

evidence.test: the render result says credits are in the file only after reading them back
a file that records no source never reports its credits as delivered

paths.note: Covered for formats in C2PA_FORMATS with Content Credentials on (a password-locked PDF is not stamped). creditsInFile is measured by reading the bytes back.

paths.title: MCP lolly_render, Chromium tier
paths.note: The web shell draws the render; the service re-establishes only the emoji census for the rights answer. Every other source the page drew is unrecorded.

paths.title: TUI export and batch export
paths.note: Stamps a credential through the shared Node options for stampable formats. No Rights block, credit or readback.

paths.title: Desktop and mobile native save and share
paths.note: Writes the bytes the web route prepared. The native save and share boundary has no test of its own for credits.

paths.title: Collaboration and nearby transfer to another device
paths.note: Not traced for rights records. Session values and asset bytes move to a peer.

paths.title: Engine writers with no product route in this tree (EPUB, plain TAR)
paths.note: writeEpub and the TAR packer are part of the engine's public surface. No web, CLI or tool route here writes an EPUB, and TAR only travels inside the Linux tar.gz package, so a host that calls these writers owns the rights handling of what it writes.

paths.title: Add to the library: drop, file picker and multi-file upload

evidence.test: a signed blob uploaded with no credential field still answers credential(id)

paths.note: A Content Credential is captured at ingest and kept beside the stored bytes. Native licence and credit fields (XMP, IPTC) are not recorded as rights evidence, and the optional strip on upload removes a third party's IPTC Credit, Source and Copyright with nothing written back. The plan 253 section 6 import sequence is not built.

paths.title: Layered files: open as layers or add flattened (PSD, PSB, XCF)
paths.note: Not traced for rights evidence. Layers become assets.

paths.title: Design import: Figma, Penpot, Illustrator, InDesign, Lottie, Premiere and Edit in Design
paths.note: Not traced for rights evidence. Bundled components keep no machine-readable rights assertions and no incomplete-coverage notice (plan 253, section 6.2).

paths.title: PDF and Office: extract content and Rebrand
paths.note: Not traced for rights evidence. Pages and slides added to the library go through the library upload.

paths.title: Files opened by a utility: Compress this PDF and Check Content Credentials
paths.note: The file is transformed or inspected on the device and is not stored as a library asset.

paths.title: Data: Open in Spreadsheet and Chart the data (CSV, XLSX, JSON)
paths.note: Rows become field values. A data source's licence is not recorded.

paths.title: Design systems and brand packs (DTCG, Tokens Studio, a brand .lolly, a pack ZIP, a PDF scan)
paths.note: Fonts and logos arrive with whatever licence strings the pack carries. Nothing is recorded as evidence and no root licence file is mapped to individual files.

paths.title: Unpack an archive to the library (ZIP, TAR, GZ)
paths.note: Members go through the library upload one by one. A root LICENSE or notice file is not associated with the members it covers (plan 253, section 6.1).

paths.title: Install a tool from a ZIP
paths.note: Installs the tool's code and bundled assets. Bundled assets' licences are not recorded as evidence.

paths.title: Open a .lolly session, project or renovation
paths.note: Not traced for whether CREDITS.txt or recorded rights decisions are read back into rights records. Works the sender held back are not in the file.

paths.title: Paste images, text and tables
paths.note: Pasted content carries no source context and nothing is inferred from a pasted name or URL. A later declaration has no interface yet.

paths.title: Remote assets fetched by URL
paths.note: Fetched when a tool asks for it and never consulted for a credential (tests/runtime-ingredients.test.ts). No source URL or licence is recorded.

paths.title: Connected providers and synced folders
paths.note: No provider adapter records a provider's creator, licence or retrieval evidence (plan 253, section 6.2).

paths.title: Screen capture, camera and microphone takes

evidence.test: every CaptureFormat is a container the engine can actually embed into

paths.note: A take is signed with its capture context. Depicted works are never guessed and no licence is inferred from them.

paths.title: Website screenshots and readings from the browser extension
paths.note: A screenshot of someone else's page arrives with no source record. Signed-in pages can hold private information; nothing here infers a licence from what the page shows.

paths.title: Inbound collaboration and nearby transfer
paths.note: Not traced for rights records.

paths.title: Asset files named on the command line
paths.note: Read as bytes. No rights evidence is captured.

paths.title: Creating and importing an emoji set
paths.note: The create flow offers the reviewed licence profiles to choose from. Not traced further.

paths.title: Catalog declarations: rights records on asset index entries

evidence.test: a work with a full rights record shows creator, licence, credit and the ask
an asset that records its licence only in the structured record is read the same way here

paths.note: A structured rights record on an index entry is read as recorded evidence. Only the emoji packs carry one today; other catalog entries carry the legacy licence and attribution strings.

paths.title: Emoji placed in text

evidence.test: the ingredients an export hands the host are byte-identical to the emoji record
every compiled specimen yields one componentOf source ingredient that binds the original bytes

paths.note: The only census that feeds the rights evaluation: each distinct glyph becomes a work and a use, recolouring read off what the renderer recorded.

paths.title: Placed assets that carry their own credential

evidence.test: a library-sourced credentialed asset rides into opts.ingredients (v1.31)
a remote-sourced asset is never consulted for a credential

paths.note: The asset's credential rides into the export as an ingredient. Its licence is not evaluated and no credit is prepared.

paths.title: Placed catalog art with a rights record and no credential
paths.note: A placed CC BY illustration produces no source ingredient, no credit and no receipt (plan 253, section 5.3).

paths.title: Credentialed bitmaps inlined by the SVG and PDF walker and Design image ops
paths.note: An inlined bitmap's credential is collected as a componentOf ingredient. No test pins the walker's collection, so no claim is made.

paths.title: Video and audio clips placed on a timeline

evidence.test: every ingredient is componentOf, whichever route found it
the id-based credential wins, and the byte scan is never reached

paths.note: A clip with a credential contributes it as an ingredient. A clip with nothing signed contributes nothing, and its licence is not read.

paths.title: Rondocode songs in a soundtrack

evidence.test: the song ingredient survives the C2PA writer and reader: name, digest, vm, algorithmic, no AI flag

paths.note: A song is recorded as a source ingredient by digest. No licence is evaluated for the song.

paths.title: Credited LUTs applied in a grade

evidence.test: videoProvenanceFor: a credited LUT names its author + rights owner in description AND parameters

paths.note: The LUT's credit rides in the colour adjustment action of the credential. It is not a source in the rights model yet, and a LUT's licence is not the photo's licence (plan 253, section 7.2).

paths.title: Assets declared as AI-generated

evidence.test: collector walks top-level assets and blocks sub-fields, dedupes, and ignores undeclared refs

paths.note: Declared AI origin is recorded as an ingredient declaration. This is disclosure, not a licence or a credit.

paths.title: Fonts used to set text and fonts embedded in a file
paths.note: The OFL profile is reviewed, but no census records which fonts a render used or embedded.

paths.title: Nested tool renders and tool links used as images
paths.note: A nested render's sources do not reach the outer export's rights evaluation. Not traced for credentials.

paths.title: Unsigned music beds, synth presets and sound effects
paths.note: Only credentialed clips and Rondocode songs are recorded; other audio sources are not.

paths.title: 3D models and textures
paths.note: Meshes and textures used by a scene do not reach the rights evaluation.

paths.title: Map data and chart data
paths.note: The street map's bundled road data and chart rows carry no source record, and the street map tool prints no data credit, so a data licence such as ODbL could not be honoured where one applies.

paths.title: Design components and templates
paths.note: A placed component's or template's own sources do not reach the rights evaluation.

mp4.note: Stamped as the container the recorder actually chose.

webm.note: Stamped as the container the recorder actually chose.

opus.note: Opus in WebM, stamped as a WebM.

evidence.test: package credits are measured from delivered bytes and missing credits never confirm delivery

lottie.note: CREDITS.txt and credits.json inside the package, read back from the delivered bytes. No signed credential is claimed for .lottie.

evidence.test: IDML package credits are measured from the delivered bytes, and a package missing them never confirms

idml.note: CREDITS.txt and credits.json inside the package, read back from the delivered bytes.

evidence.test: Premiere package credits are measured from the delivered bytes, and a package missing them never confirms

premiere-xml.note: CREDITS.txt and credits.json inside the package, read back from the delivered bytes.

jxl.note: The runtime promises neither a credential nor a readable credit for JPEG XL, so no credit travels in the file.

bmp.note: No credential container. The receipt reads the bytes back and reports the credit as not delivered.

ico.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

svgz.note: The gzip wrapper is not stampable by the export bridge, so the receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

emf.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

wmf.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

dxf.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

eps.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

eps-cmyk.note: No credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

exr.note: Deep float output with no credential container.

hdr.note: Deep float output with no credential container.

pptx.note: Office core properties carry the person's own details; no source credit is written and the receipt reports it as not delivered.

docx.note: Office core properties carry the person's own details; no source credit is written.

penpot.note: No credential container and no credits file.

scorm.note: Built by the export panel from the rendered pages (bridge/export-scorm.ts), outside renderFormatDispatch. Not traced for credentials or receipts.

ase.note: Bytes supplied by the tool's exportStill hook, with no engine provenance.

ttf.note: Produced by a tool hook with no engine provenance. A font's own licence is not checked before the file is passed on.

zip.note: The ZIP container carries no credential and no credits index binding members to their sources, so a receipt measured on it cannot confirm credits.

aac.note: Bare ADTS has no credential container. The receipt reports the credit as not delivered.

rpm.note: A Linux package around an inner render. The inner file goes through the same route and may carry its credential; the package itself carries none and no credits file.

tar.gz.note: As rpm, as a no-root archive.
